newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed up by 0.28 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 513.30 from 511.85 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 1.09 million dinars against 1.38 million dinars over the previous session.

Chemical firm Al-Kimia won 1.3 dinar to 48 dinars. Banque de Tunisie was up 0.5 dinar to 76. Chemical firm ICF gained 0.44 dinar to 55.8 dinars. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel rose 0.41 dinar to 13.75.
Airline Tunis Air gained 0.22 dinar to 22.58 dinars with 11,388 shares changing hands.
BNA bank fell 0.92 dinar to 29.88 dinars. Banque du Sud was down 0.81 dinar to 26.12.
Leasing firn Tunisie Leasing slid 0.2 dinar to 33.1. Placement de Tunisie declined 0.19 dinar to 14.8 dinars. ($1= 1.07 dinar)
